findings.note: Roll call 758 on HB 958, Election Law Changes, second reading. The member's page records her vote as No. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) includes a removal process for voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database, a requirement that a registration applicant state citizenship, and a sworn citizenship statement for applications left blank. It has no photo-ID changes in the text searched.

Roll call 801 on HB 958, Election Law Changes, motion to concur in the Senate version. The member's page records her vote as No. The bill passed the House 62 to 47 (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookup/2025/H958).
